title: A metre from the Earth itself

probes.question: True or false: the metre was defined as one ten-millionth of the distance from the North Pole to the Equator.
Why was a pendulum length a poor standard for the metre?
options: It was too long to carry around
It could not be written down

image.alt: A carved marble standard metre bar set into a wall beneath the word METRE in Paris

body.question: When revolutionary France built the metric system, how was the metre defined?
options: The length of a pendulum that swings once a second
One ten-millionth of the distance from the North Pole to the Equator
The length of the king's arm
body.reveal: On 7 April 1795 the metre was defined in French law as one ten-millionth of the distance from the North Pole to the Equator, through Paris. A pendulum had been proposed as a standard, but pendulum lengths varied from place to place.
